title: (R)RE.DOC.-----AF.DY.
description: Diagram in TRF(II)-17. The prose above identifies the structural target: 'the collective forces of western culture function as a negative factor with regards to the actualness of creativity from every sector of the planet - especially if the creator is not a white man.' The crossing diagrams how reality-of-redocumentation structurally meets affinity-dynamics at the creative-women-evaluation scale: (R)RE-DOC crossed with AF-DY. RE-DOC sits at left with the subject-arrow; AF-DY at center-bottom as partner-axis. C-INFO (central information), MT-INTR (meta-introduction), STF (structural-formal) upper chain. INDIV-TD (individual transformation-dynamics) center, T-C-IMP (temporal-continuity implication) right. SG (source-generation) center. CULT-INFO-DY (cultural-information dynamics), CULT-SOLD (culture-soldered) right. VT-DY (vibrational dynamics), PER-DY (perceived dynamics), TR (transformation) on the lower-left chain. RT-DY (reality dynamics) lower-center.
